Registered by BH-1494 so the runner-CLI list this lane updates is visible; NOT settable from the control plane — it is a list of executables a root lane installs, so only env/global.env on the box moves it, and the reviewed default lives beside the floors in catalog/cli-min-versions.json.

BH-6041: the /tmp tmpfs size bin/tmpfs-ensure.sh declares, as a percent of MemTotal (whole GB, rounded down, never below 4G). This lane runs it daily and bin/bootstrap-machine.sh on first boot. It acts only when /tmp is already a tmpfs and only grows it: a remount plus one fstab line, so a reboot keeps the size. 50 on a 16 GB box is 8G.
